name: x-MoneyForWhiskas
headline: Same bot as GoodFallen and dangerously-skip-permissions: identical price and timing distributions, thousands of shared transactions, and direct fills against its sibling wallets. No public-data rule matches it, public-data versions lose, and below the top rebate tier its month falls to about $33k.
mechanism: 291k fills in 30 days, all BTC 5-minute Up/Down; buys both outcomes in 88% of windows at a median pair cost of 1.008; 40% maker fills (on-chain, 95% CI 34-47%). Price quantiles (0.16/0.32/0.48/0.64/0.82) and within-window timing match GoodFallen exactly. 30-day income: gross trading $120.5k, taker fees -$91.7k, taker rebate +$48.6k (53%), maker rebate +$4.7k.

match.detail: spot-latency taker: held-out AUC 0.525 (perm p=0.97); directional maker: AUC 0.460 (p=0.85)

backtest.detail: public-data taker rule -$6.9k (p=0.62) and public-data maker -15.6% on 288 held-out windows

replicable.detail: sub-second edge not visible in 1-second public data; cross-wallet self-trading; at 0% rebate tier ~$33k/month

persistence.detail: last 30 days significant (p=7e-5), no decline (p=0.40); depends on the Taker Rebate Program

reasons: No reverse-engineered rule matches its decisions on held-out windows.
Public-data versions of the strategy lose money.
Coordinated with two sibling wallets that trade against each other; needs the top rebate tier to clear $50k/month.
